faq.q: What is the Goethe-Zertifikat C2: Großes Deutsches Sprachdiplom?
faq.a: It is the Goethe-Institut's highest German certificate, at C2 level. It shows a near-native command of German for academic, professional and literary use.

faq.q: Is German C2 only for native-level speakers?
faq.a: No, but it needs strong C1 skills. A level check with our trainers in Dehradun tells you whether to join the C2 course or strengthen C1 first.

faq.q: Who should take the German C2 course?
faq.a: Teachers, translators, researchers and professionals who use German at the highest level, and learners who completed C1 and want the top Goethe certificate.

faq.q: How big are German C2 batches?
faq.a: We keep advanced batches small so each learner gets detailed feedback on writing, speaking and exam strategy.

faq.q: Can I prepare for the C2 exam online from Dehradun?
faq.a: Yes. C2 preparation is available online and at our Race Course centre in Dehradun, with personalised sessions for each exam module.
